description: A sidebar item (DESIGN.md, Sidebar): TsuyaSize.controlSm tall (TsuyaSize.target on touch), TsuyaRadius.sm, icon and label in TsuyaType.control TsuyaColors.textMuted, count at the end; the current one in TsuyaColors.text on TsuyaColors.fillStrong. Collapsed, the icon only, still named label (count is left out while collapsed, drawn and named alike); its label shows as a Tooltip at its end.

constructors.description: An item labelled label, shown over icon, current when it names the page already shown.

params.name: label
params.description: The item's label: shown unless the sidebar is collapsed, and always its accessible name (with count, when there is one: "Albums 12").

params.name: count
params.description: A number at the end (such as unread items); hidden, but not its own name, while collapsed.

params.name: current
params.description: Whether it names the page already shown.

params.name: onPressed
params.description: Called on a press; null disables it.
